results.basis: Kano Municipal Council's own 2025 budget spreadsheet lists 'Federal Allocation' as a named revenue line (₦4,586,665,421) — the Federation Account distribution the Allocation of Revenue Act governs. The document names the revenue category but does not itself quote the Act's percentage formula, so 'cites' rather than 'calculated_from'.

targetReport.title: Allocation of Revenue (Federation Account, etc.) Act
targetReport.description: The federal statute prescribing the vertical distribution of the Federation Account: "the Federal Government 56.00 per cent; the State Governments 24.00 per cent; the Local Government Councils 20.00 per cent," and establishing FAAC. Full text searched for "Lagos" -- zero matches. Horizontal (inter-state) shares are allocated only by general factors (equality, population, land mass, social development indices), never listing individual states.
targetReport.cadence_note: Original Act commenced 22 January 1982; amended 1992 No.106 and by S.I. 9 of 2002 as printed in the retrieved text.
